title: SessKit Stats Ledger (sesskit.stats/v1)
description: Windowed active-time ledger per session or per project (full cwd grouping): bounded numbers, identifiers, and computation evidence only. Never message text, history paths, or credentials. Only load_activity event timestamps inside [since, until] seed intervals (out-of-window records are dropped, never clipped in); intervals merge within active_gap, extend event_tail past each range end, clip to the window, and truncate live sessions at now. Totals cover the full window set before any --top trim; missing stays missing (null), never a fabricated zero.

schema.description: Dataset version; the CLI envelope version is separate

backend.description: Whether aggregation ran on the locked sesskit.stats core (real) or a degraded CLI-local stub (stub-degraded)

since.description: Requested window start as unix timestamp

until.description: Requested window end as unix timestamp

params.description: Computation evidence: interval-merge inputs actually applied

sessions.description: Present when by is session, sorted by active_seconds descending

projects.description: Present when by is project, sorted by active_seconds_sum descending; empty cwd groups under __missing_cwd__

totals.description: Totals cover the full window set, before any --top trim

load_errors.description: Unreadable histories only; readable histories with zero window activity are simply absent

cwd.description: Full project working directory (ledger grouping key; never a history path)
